create.name: Drepung Loseling México
create.bio:
Drepung Loseling México is a Tibetan Buddhist centre in Coyoacán, Mexico City, and the official Mexican seat of Drepung Loseling Monastery in south India, whose tradition reaches back more than six centuries. It opened in October 2013 at the Dalai Lama's request. Two fully ordained Tibetan monks live and teach there: Geshe Sherab Choephel, a graduate of the monastery who is the spiritual director, and the chant master Geshe Tsering Norbu, who leads pujas and rituals. The centre describes its aims as passing on Tibetan Buddhist study and meditation to Mexico and Latin America and helping keep Tibetan culture alive.

It teaches in person and online, in Spanish: weekly courses in Buddhist philosophy and shamatha meditation open to newcomers of any belief, a free Sunday guided meditation, ceremonies and festivals of the Tibetan calendar, Emory University's CBCT compassion training and SEE Learning for educators, and retreats in Mexico and a yearly pilgrimage to the monastery and Bodhgaya in India. Its YouTube channel, running since 2013, carries recorded courses, guided Tara meditations, festival practices and short explanations of Tibetan Buddhist ideas.

courses.title: Cursos y clases
courses.description: Ongoing classes in Tibetan Buddhist philosophy and meditation, in person in Coyoacán and online. Taught by the resident geshes and certified teachers in a repeating format, so beginners can join at any point.

courses.title: Retiro y peregrinación en India
courses.description: A two-week pilgrimage from the last week of December 2026 to early January 2027 (dates to be confirmed): teachings and empowerments at Drepung Loseling in south India, then Bodhgaya, Nalanda and Vulture Peak. Lodging, vegetarian meals and internal travel are included; international flights are not.

free_resources.title: Meditación gratuita de los domingos
free_resources.description: A free online shamatha session every Sunday morning, 20 to 30 minutes long and guided by Lopönma Lobsang Drölma; open to beginners with registration.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube 6,740 subscribers (YouTube Data API, 10 Nov 2026); no other counts read → ~7k → local_hero
flags: Email Infoloseling@gmail.com is the mailto link on every page; the footer also shows info@loseling.org.mx as text. Organisational inbox.
Only one photo: the centre's emblem (channel avatar). The site's own images are icons, posters and a pilgrimage group shot taken in India, none clearly the Coyoacán centre.
Geshe Sherab Choephel and Geshe Tsering Norbu (resident teachers) are not on Spiritpedia: possible future listings. Teachers file empty.
Pilgrimage dates are 'to be confirmed' on the page, so start/end dates are left null and the dates given in the description; the price is a donation of $55,000 MXN excluding dana.
Class prices aren't published: 'Contact for pricing'. Courses running November–December 2026 have already started.
Possible duplicate context: Drepung Loseling's US centre (Atlanta) appears in other plans; this is its separate Mexican seat.
left_out: Medicine Buddha meditations framed around healing body and mind, a talk on meditation and mental health, and a course on reducing anger and envy (borderline emotional framing).
A Padmasambhava meditation framed as 'materialising your goals'; promotional clips under a minute.
